meta.title: Master QCS tab shows the evaluation summary on the latest commercial stage
gaps: Confirm that the opened Master QCS is specifically for the latest commercial stage (RFQ or auction) rather than another stage.
Verify the complete final-versus-initial price comparison when the product exposes values under client-specific or unknown row labels.
Verify technical rankings across stages and all client-configured custom columns.
Verify charges for every stage when their labels or values are not exposed through the catalog's known Master QCS rows.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Confirm that the opened Master QCS is specifically for the latest commercial stage (RFQ or auction) rather than another stage.; Verify the complete final-versus-initial price comparison when the product exposes values under client-specific or unknown row labels.; Verify technical rankings across stages and all client-configured custom columns.; Verify charges for every stage when their labels or values are not exposed through the catalog's known Master QCS rows.

steps.note: Open the prepared event directly on its Master QCS screen, which contains the commercial bids needed for the evaluation summary.
Assert that the comparison grid has real vendor columns rather than placeholders.
Check that the commercial unit-price comparison cell is populated.
Check that the commercial line amount is populated.
Check that a commercial ranking value is displayed.
Verify the displayed commercial amounts equal rate multiplied by quantity and that totals reconcile.
Verify commercial ranks follow the displayed buy-event amounts.
Assert that the known final RFQ pricing section is present in Master QCS.
Assert that the known charges section is present in Master QCS.
